cd /workspace
# Try several header combinations to find the prefetch RSC payload
echo "=== A: RSC + purpose prefetch ==="
curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'purpose: prefetch' "http://localhost:3210/catalog?category=featured" -o /tmp/a.txt -w "bytes=%{size_download}\n"
grep -aoE 'Loading category|Featured products|Desk Lamp' /tmp/a.txt | sort | uniq -c
echo "=== B: RSC + Next-Router-Prefetch ==="
curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' "http://localhost:3210/catalog?category=featured" -o /tmp/b.txt -w "bytes=%{size_download}\n"
grep -aoE 'Loading category|Featured products|Desk Lamp' /tmp/b.txt | sort | uniq -c
echo "=== C: RSC + Next-Router-Prefetch + purpose ==="
curl -s -H 'RSC: 1' -H 'Next-Router-Prefetch: 1' -H 'purpose: prefetch' "http://localhost:3210/catalog?category=featured" -o /tmp/c.txt -w "bytes=%{size_download}\n"
